cause_quote: The introducing diff calls `refreshAll();` when the usage sidecar starts and `await work.drain();` when it stops, so startup rollback can wait on a refresh whose database admission turn does not observe cancellation.
user_saw: After startup failed, the Gateway process took nearly three minutes to exit.
summary: The fix makes usage discovery and scan admission cancellable and bounds startup rollback when the CLI process will exit.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and the worker code at that revision: the new startup sidecar joined refresh work on shutdown, and cold SQLite admission already waited for its predecessor without observing the abort signal. A later change added a separate uncancellable roster read, and the production log identifies the usage sidecar but leaves the exact wait unconfirmed.
